entities.summary: Nikolaus Meyer-Landrut is a German diplomat currently serving as the German ambassador to the Netherlands. He was the Head of the EU Delegation to Turkey. He was previously German Ambassador to France from 2015 to 2020. Before that, he served as the chief adviser for European affairs to the German Chancellor, Angela Merkel.
